explanation: When the actuator saturates the integral term keeps growing, which causes big overshoot later. You can fix it by clamping the integrator.
Integral windup happens when the derivative gain is too high, and the fix is to raise Ki.
Glycolysis happens in the cytoplasm without oxygen and splits glucose into two pyruvates, netting 2 ATP and 2 NADH.
Glycolysis happens inside the mitochondria and needs oxygen, and it makes about 30 ATP.
Proteins in the inner mitochondrial membrane pump protons, and ATP synthase uses the proton flow back to make ATP. Oxygen is the final electron acceptor and forms water.
The electron transport chain is in the chloroplast and carbon dioxide is the final electron acceptor.
A hash function maps keys to buckets for average O(1) lookups. Collisions are handled with chaining or open addressing, and the table resizes when the load factor is high.
Hash tables keep keys sorted, so lookup is O(log n), and collisions are impossible with a good hash.
BFS uses a queue and visits nodes by distance in edges, so it finds shortest paths in unweighted graphs.
BFS uses a stack and goes as deep as possible first, and it finds shortest paths in weighted graphs.
A min-heap stores a complete tree in an array, the minimum is read in O(1), and push and pop take O(log n).
In a min-heap every parent is larger than its children and popping the minimum is O(1).
